description: One persistent Saint calling. Reset returns believers to autonomous needs. Oracle differences reallocate feasible actions; cross-settlement core doubt requires real local deficit, demonstrated rival outcome, and live preaching contact.

semantics.food: food.produce increases real field/forage labor and reduces discretionary nonfood work. No free food.
semantics.nurture: family.nurture trades away some other labor and frontier chances for care work, bounded child recovery and greater conception chance only with real family care.
semantics.explore: settlement.explore improves feasible building/supply choices and pioneer opportunity, without creating homes or settlers.
semantics.counters: food loses to demonstrated rival nurture when child care was missed; nurture loses to proven rival housing when its home pressure remains; explore loses to rival reserves when it has genuinely short food coverage. Cross-town live sermon encounter is sampled; no forced conversion. After credible doubt brings faith below the existing 40 threshold, time-bounded follow-up requires an actual current preacher from that source town. Existing below-20 conversion rules apply, no artificial followers.
semantics.reset: life.balance ends active Saint specializations immediately, free of quota/DP, with zero rollback or direct Devotion changes; new specialization still consumes issue quota.
semantics.scope: opt-in only. Does not rewrite existing saves or former P2 fingerprints. Local Divine Presence still controls aggressive miracles.
semantics.faithDefense: Row is the receiving citizen's doctrine and column the credible challenger Oracle. Defensive multiplier 0.4 means resistance at 40%, 1.6 means 160%; chance of earned doubt is counterContactChance / defense, capped at faithDefenseChanceCeiling. After a witnessed event, the same resistance applies to bounded below-40/below-20 follow-up. No continuous Faith damage. Missing explore/default is intentionally 1:1; same vs same is always 1:1.
